pattern: SELECT count\(DISTINCT ([a-z]+)_id\) FROM matches WHERE tournament_name = '(.*?)' AND winner_hand = '\'(.*?)\'
correction: Replace 'count(DISTINCT [column])' with 'count(DISTINCT [table].[column])'. Replace '[column]' with the correct column name.

metadata.description: This rule identifies instances where the count of distinct column IDs is being calculated instead of the correct column name.
